title: Change from NSv3 to NSv1 : no more connection
symptom: After switching from NSv3 to NSv1 in AAPS, the app cannot connect to Nightscout web, showing an error, while switching back to NSv3 restores connectivity. The Nightscout site is functional and the API secret is correct.
cause: The thread suggests that NSv1 may not be compatible with Nightscout v15 (dev), as indicated by a Discord message referenced by robertrub. However, this is not fully confirmed, and some users report v1 works fine with dev.
fix: The issue was closed by robertrub after noting that v1 doesn't work with NS v15 according to a Discord message. No specific fix was provided; users either stay on NSv3 or continue using NSv1 if it works.
evidence_quote: as your message on Discord AAPS, it seems normal that v1 doesn't work with NS v15
